enum class Flagged(val value: Boolean) {
    TRUE(true),
    FALSE(false);

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: Boolean): Flagged = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}

enum class Label(val value: String) {
    WORK("work"),
    PERSONAL("personal");

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: String): Label = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}

enum class Priority(val value: Int) {
    _1(1),
    _2(2),
    _3(3);

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: Int): Priority = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}

enum class Score(val value: Double) {
    _1(1.0),
    _2_5(2.5),
    _3(3.0);

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: Double): Score = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}

data class Ticket(
    val flagged: Flagged? = null,
    val label: Label? = null,
    val priority: Priority,
    val relatedPriorities: List<Priority>? = null,
    val score: Score? = null,
    val severity: TicketSeverity? = null
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["flagged"] = flagged?.value
        map["label"] = label?.value
        map["priority"] = priority.value
        map["relatedPriorities"] = relatedPriorities?.map { it.value }
        map["score"] = score?.value
        map["severity"] = severity?.value
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Ticket {
            return Ticket(
                flagged = (json["flagged"] as? Boolean)?.let { Flagged.fromValue(it) },
                label = (json["label"] as? String)?.let { Label.fromValue(it) },
                priority = Priority.fromValue((json["priority"] as Number).toInt()),
                relatedPriorities = (json["relatedPriorities"] as? List<*>)?.map { Priority.fromValue((it as Number).toInt()) },
                score = ((json["score"] as? Number)?.toDouble())?.let { Score.fromValue(it) },
                severity = ((json["severity"] as? Number)?.toInt())?.let { TicketSeverity.fromValue(it) }
            )
        }
    }
}

enum class TicketSeverity(val value: Int) {
    _1(1),
    _2(2),
    _3(3);

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: Int): TicketSeverity = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}
